ChildMinutesLst.Title: A. Reece Nichols Real Estate Rising Stars Program
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Motion by Fritz was seconded by Smith to accept the assistant superintendents recommendation and approve the partnership with Reece Nichols Rising Stars Program.
The motion carried 6-0-0.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: B. Approval of Wide Area Network/WAN Vendor
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Motion by Fritz was seconded by Ball to accept the recommendation of Segra's WAN proposal of a 10 Gigabyte resilient fiber network for $4,200 per month for a term of 10 years utilizing e-rate program to reduce district funding to approximately a 10% of the total project cost.
The motion carried 6-0-0.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: C. Approval to Purchase Equip - Zero Turn Mowers
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Motion by Fritz was seconded by Sarver to accept the recommendation of the Director of Maintenance to purchase two mowers from the current grounds' equipment budget and purchase two SCAG 72 inch mowers through the OMNIA purchasing coop at a cost not to exceed $34,006.
The motion carried 6-0-0.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: D. Approval to Purchase Equip - Auto Scrubber
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:

The motion carried 6-0-0.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: E. Furniture for Boone Elementary
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Motion by Fritz was seconded by Ball to approve the recommendation of the Assistant Superintendent of Accelerated Learning to purchase new classroom flexible furniture and chairs for Boone Elementary. Funds to cover the $125,348.00 will be split between the Title funds and district funds.
The motion carried 6-0-0. 

Board member Boydston entered the meeting at 7:59pm.

The motion carried 6-0-1.
